name: Private Limited
description: Privately owned commercial entity registered under the Companies Act, with restricted share transfers.

name: Public Limited
description: Publicly traded company listed on a stock exchange, allowing shares to be bought and sold by the general public.

name: Limited Liability Partnership
description: A business partnership structure where some or all partners have limited liabilities and flexible internal management.

name: Sole Proprietorship
description: An unincorporated business owned and run by a single individual with direct personal liability for all debts.

name: Partnership Firm
description: A standard business structure where two or more individuals manage and operate a business based on a partnership deed.

name: One Person Company
description: A corporate entity formed with only one single member, combining the features of a sole proprietorship and a private limited firm.

name: Non-Profit Organization
description: An entity set up dedicated to a specific social, educational, religious, or charitable cause, with no profits distributed to members.

name: Government Enterprise / PSU
description: State-owned or public sector undertaking where the government owns 51% or more of the corporate equity share capital.

name: Multinational Corporation
description: An enterprise operating facilities and assets in at least one country other than its home country.

name: Subsidiary Company
description: A corporate entity whose voting stock is more than 50% controlled by another parent or holding company.
